title: Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial systems to sabotage factories, utilities, and food production across the West, Bloomberg reports
summary: Bloomberg reports Russia-linked hackers are exploiting poorly secured industrial control systems to disrupt factories, utilities and food production across Western countries.

title: Researchers uncover Volt Typhoon’s covert, ephemeral network
summary: Researchers describe a covert, ephemeral network built by the Volt Typhoon China-linked group after US law enforcement disruption, targeting critical infrastructure operators.

title: CISA Unveils New Strategy to Strengthen National Cyber Defense and Critical Infrastructure Security
summary: CISA released a new national strategy aimed at strengthening cyber defense and critical infrastructure security, setting direction for operators and federal partners.

title: US Coast Guard releases NVIC 02-26 to guide maritime operators on cybersecurity plans, IT and OT risk assessments
summary: The US Coast Guard issued NVIC 02-26, guidance for maritime operators on cybersecurity plans and IT/OT risk assessments, relevant to compliance planning for regulated vessels and facilities.

title: MythicRatatoskr: An Yggdrasil-enabled backdoor deployed in a UAC-0099-Sandworm collaboration
summary: Sandworm and UAC-0099 carried out a destructive wiper attack on a Ukrainian logistics company in 2025, using a new mesh network backdoor, per ESET research. Shows state actors using OT-adjacent destructive tooling against critical infrastructure supply chains.

title: Cold Chain, Open Control: Exposed Refrigeration Systems Reveal Global Risk
summary: Forescout Vedere Labs analyzes recent physical and financial disruptions at French refrigeration control systems caused without malware, and flags exposed refrigeration controls as a global risk.

title: SafePay ransomware compromised 600 critical organizations worldwide; urge patching and network defenses
summary: CISA, FBI and partners warn that SafePay ransomware has compromised about 600 critical infrastructure organizations worldwide, urging patching and stronger network defenses.

title: Accenture, Dragos and SANS Institute launch $10 million initiative to strengthen cybersecurity at US utilities
summary: Accenture, Dragos and SANS launched a $10M initiative to help under-resourced US utilities strengthen cyber defenses, with free tools, equipment, deployment help and training.

title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
summary: CISA, FBI and partners issued a joint advisory on SafePay ransomware targeting multiple critical infrastructure sectors, with indicators and mitigations for defenders.
